pixel-calculator.description:
Elevate your daily math with a calculator that looks as good as it functions.

This isn't just another standard calculator app. It is a fully customizable, feature-rich tool designed for students, professionals, and anyone who appreciates clean aesthetics and powerful utility. From simple math to complex equations, this app adapts to exactly what you need.

Key Features:

Advanced Scientific Calculator: Need more power? Expand the calculator to access a full suite of scientific functions. Easily calculate trigonometry (sin, cos, tan), logarithms (log, ln), square roots, powers, factorials, and constants like π and e. It even includes a toggle for Degree and Radian modes, plus an "inv" button for inverse functions.

Deep Customization (Themes & Shapes): Make it truly yours. Switch effortlessly between a crisp White theme and a sleek Dark theme. Tailor the interface further by choosing your preferred button shape—Pill, Square, or Circle—and pick from a variety of vibrant accent colors to match your style.

Integrated Unit Converter: Say goodbye to searching for conversion charts. The built-in converter handles multiple categories, including Length, Area, Volume, Weight, Temperature, Speed, Pressure, and Power. Input your value (e.g., Kilometers) and get instant, highly accurate conversions (e.g., Miles).

Built-in Notepad: Need to jot down a quick number or a multi-step equation before calculating? Slide up the integrated Notes panel to type your thoughts. It saves automatically, so you never lose your work while switching between screens.

Calculation History: Never lose a number again. The dedicated History screen keeps a running log of your previous equations. Just tap the history icon to view past calculations and easily clear them when you're done.

Intuitive & Clean UI: Designed with a focus on user experience, featuring large, easy-to-read numbers and responsive buttons. Seamlessly switch between the standard keypad and the scientific layout with a single tap.

Whether you are balancing a budget in Dark Mode, converting units for a project, or solving complex trigonometric equations in Scientific View, this calculator delivers a premium, personalized experience.
